remarks: Extraordinary opportunity. A gracious country estate in the highly sought-after Westover neighborhood, set on a stately and private property with mature gardens, in-ground pool, fountain and large patio ideal for outdoor entertaining. This custom built 5-bedroom, 5-bath home blends classic architecture with subtle European designer influences throughout. Meticulous care devoted to upgrade this stunning 1941 classic Georgian brick house with today's conveniences.  A covered entry and fencing of traditional balusters welcomes you into a home designed for both comfortable living and elegant gatherings, featuring an oversized living room with wood-burning fireplace, gleaming hardwood floors throughout, grand formal dining room, sunroom, primary bedroom with 2 walk-in closets, balcony and fireplace. A first-floor breakfast room adjoins kitchen with new appliances that flow into a formal dining room and office with fireplace. Architectural highlights include front and back staircases, slate roof, and large oversized windows where every room has an unobstructed view of the park-like property. A two-car attached garage and Belgian block-lined driveway complete this Westover property offering privacy, character, and convenient access to downtown Stamford, Metro-North, and local amenities.
